{{Top|leg}}
'''Sterile Heating Cloths''' were standard items included in [[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]]'s [[ECM-598 Medical Backpack]]. Measuring 1.6 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] by 0.75 meters, they were a sterilized, heat-insulated covering.
